tokens.name: paper-0
tokens.usage: Backs surface-raised.

tokens.name: amber-800
tokens.usage: Backs text-link — the ochre that marks everything you can follow or press without filling it.

tokens.name: amber-700
tokens.usage: Backs on-surface-avatar.

tokens.name: amber-650
tokens.usage: Backs status-low-stock — the meter of a batch that is running out. A step deeper than amber-600 so the fill holds 3:1 against both the card and the empty track in light mode.

tokens.name: amber-600
tokens.usage: Backs status-pending.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Backs ring-focus — the outer half of the two-tone focus ring.

tokens.name: amber-400
tokens.usage: Backs brand-accent. Same as amber-500 in light mode; a step deeper in dark so the wordmark dot is not mistaken for a focus ring.

tokens.name: amber-150
tokens.usage: Backs surface-avatar and surface-accent.

tokens.name: amber-75
tokens.usage: Backs surface-tint.

tokens.name: amber-50
tokens.usage: Backs surface-badge.

tokens.name: amber-25
tokens.usage: Backs surface-reconcile.

tokens.name: moss-600
tokens.usage: Backs on-surface-success. Success is the one place the palette keeps a green, so a confirmation never reads as the ochre accent.

tokens.name: moss-50
tokens.usage: Backs surface-success.

tokens.name: clay-700
tokens.usage: Backs on-surface-error.

tokens.name: clay-600
tokens.usage: Backs status-danger. A brick red, the only warning hue in the system.

tokens.name: clay-200
tokens.usage: Backs border-error.

tokens.name: clay-50
tokens.usage: Backs surface-error.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Body background. Everything else sits above it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and control fills.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Identity card, the selected category and checked theme-choice — a warm ochre step above surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill.

tokens.name: surface-avatar
tokens.usage: Initials-avatar circle fill. Pairs with on-surface-avatar (7.47:1 light, 8.11:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-badge
tokens.usage: Draft-status pill fill. Carries text-primary at 13.85:1 light, 11.79:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-success
tokens.usage: Success notice fill. Pairs with on-surface-success (7.49:1 light, 9.69:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-error
tokens.usage: Error notice fill. Pairs with on-surface-error (8.84:1 light, 8.98:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-reconcile
tokens.usage: Reconcile panel fill — a server/draft conflict. Deliberately neither the error nor the success tint: it is a decision, not a fault. Carries text-primary at 13.95:1 light, 11.03:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind a dialog. Never a ground for text.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface-page, surface-raised, surface-tint, surface-badge and surface-reconcile — 11:1 or better on each, in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Ledes, eyebrows, help text, footer copy. On surface-page 5.71:1 light / 8.94:1 dark; on surface-raised 6.27:1 / 8.15:1; on surface-tint 5.46:1 / 7.27:1.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Text inside a disabled control, on surface-sunken (4.62:1 light, 5.85:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Anchor text, secondary-button label, text-button label, and the border of an input while it has focus. On surface-page 6.30:1 light / 11.11:1 dark; on the secondary-button fill 6.57:1 / 8.82:1.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action-primary (13.93:1 light, 14.60:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-surface-avatar
tokens.usage: Initials on surface-avatar.

tokens.name: on-surface-success
tokens.usage: Text on surface-success.

tokens.name: on-surface-error
tokens.usage: Text on surface-error.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines — card edges, header and footer rules, table dividers. Deliberately near-invisible (1.20:1 light, 1.86:1 dark): nothing that carries meaning may rely on it alone.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The resting boundary of every control — inputs, textareas, selects and secondary buttons. Clears the 3:1 non-text floor: 3.53:1 on surface-page, 3.87:1 on surface-raised, 3.68:1 on the secondary-button fill in light; 4.72:1 / 4.30:1 / 3.75:1 in dark.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Control border under the pointer — one visible step darker than border-control in light mode, lighter in dark. Focus moves it again, to text-link.

tokens.name: border-badge
tokens.usage: Draft-pill border. Decorative: the pill's fill and text carry its meaning.

tokens.name: border-success
tokens.usage: Success notice border. Decorative reinforcement of the fill.

tokens.name: border-error
tokens.usage: Error notice border. Decorative reinforcement of the fill.

tokens.name: border-reconcile
tokens.usage: Reconcile panel border. Decorative reinforcement of the fill.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill; also the brand-mark circle and the skip link. Graphite, not ochre: the accent marks links and focus, the main action stays the darkest thing on the page.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill. In light mode it sits within 1.04:1 of surface-page on purpose — border-control is what makes the button a button, which is why that token must hold 3:1.

tokens.name: action-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: action-text-hover
tokens.usage: Text-button fill under the pointer — the only fill a text button ever takes.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Field-error text and the border of an invalid control. On surface-raised 7.35:1 light, 9.51:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-pending
tokens.usage: The loading dot, for anything in flight. 4.41:1 on surface-page, 4.84:1 on surface-raised in light.

tokens.name: status-low-stock
tokens.usage: Fill of the batch meter when a batch is running out (two or fewer left and no more than a third of the batch). Any other batch meter is text-primary graphite. On surface-raised 4.35:1 light / 8.93:1 dark; against the border-subtle track 3.30:1 / 5.28:1. The words beside the meter carry the meaning; the ochre only marks it.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Outer half of the focus ring, 3px at 3px offset. In light mode the ochre reads only 2.2–2.5:1 against the pale grounds, so it never stands alone: ring-focus-inner carries the contrast and the ochre identifies the ring.

tokens.name: ring-focus-inner
tokens.usage: Inner half of the focus ring, 3px hugging the element. A dark ink in both themes: 7.70:1 against the outer ochre in light, 9.43:1 in dark, and always high against a pale control fill.

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: The wordmark's full stop and the principle-card glyphs. Never an interactive state and never text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page h1, one per page, always a full sentence with a period. Mobile fixed at 3.1rem. The only serif moment on a screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and card titles that need presence without becoming the page h1. Added to fill the gap between heading and display — the source jumped straight from 24.8px to 45px, so card headings had been borrowing h2 at an ad-hoc 1.35rem.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Вход выполнен. Нам нужно немного времени.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Небольшие детали, из которых складывается знакомство.
styles.usage: Intro copy under a heading. Same size as body — what makes it a lede is text-secondary, the looser leading and a measure capped near 52ch.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and h4. Merges the source's two near-identical steps (0.82rem labels, 0.9rem h4).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field help text and masthead meta.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section kicker above a heading, in text-secondary. Raised from the source's 0.65rem: at uppercase with this tracking, 10.4px was the smallest thing on the page.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Section numbers and field counters. Same size as caption; tabular numerals and wider tracking are what set it apart.

tokens.name: sp-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets — label-to-count gap.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Label-to-control gap, button-row gap.

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Brand mark-to-wordmark gap, badge padding, dialog action gap.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Notice padding, panel padding on phone.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, reconcile-panel padding, address-list gap.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields, card padding on phone, nav gap.

tokens.name: sp-7
tokens.usage: Header gap, form-footer margin, dialog padding.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop (currently 34–38px), page-heading margin (38px).

tokens.name: sp-9
tokens.usage: Main top padding (58px), state-card padding.

tokens.name: sp-10
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, auth-grid gap (70px).

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: The skip link. Tokenized so no component style needs a bare pixel value.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects and notices. Inputs and notices moved here from the source's 9px, as its own token file proposed.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Panels, the reconcile panel, address rows, theme-choice rows.

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Cards — identity, state, auth and dialog.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: The draft-status badge.

tokens.name: r-round
tokens.usage: Circles — the avatar, the brand mark, the loading dot.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Minimum height of an input, textarea or select.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a button.

tokens.name: button-h-compact
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a compact button — session controls only. The floor for anything interactive in this system.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the centred page column.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 1000px and above; 35px between 720 and 1000; 22px below 720.

tokens.name: elevation-card
tokens.usage: The only shadow in the product, on .card. Near-invisible in light mode by design; raised to 19% alpha in dark, where borders read weaker.
